name: Nintendo Entertainment System
biosNotes: Cartridge ROMs run without BIOS. Famicom Disk System (.fds) images require disksys.rom.
description: 8-bit cartridge home console powered by the Ricoh 2A03 processor.

name: Super Nintendo
biosNotes: No system BIOS required for standard Super Famicom or SNES cartridges.
description: 16-bit console featuring Mode 7 scaling and Sony SPC700 audio.

name: Game Boy / Color
biosNotes: Optional boot ROMs (gb_bios.bin, gbc_bios.bin) enable the authentic startup chime and logo.
description: Dot-matrix and color handheld platforms built on Sharp LR35902 silicon.

name: Game Boy Advance
biosNotes: Built-in HLE BIOS handles most software; gba_bios.bin improves SWI edge-case accuracy.
description: 32-bit ARM7TDMI handheld console with hardware sprite and tile blending.

name: Sega Genesis / Mega Drive
biosNotes: Cartridge games run without BIOS; Sega CD titles require bios_CD_U.bin, bios_CD_E.bin, or bios_CD_J.bin.
description: Motorola 68000-based 16-bit console with YM2612 FM synthesis.

name: Sega Master System
biosNotes: Optional Master System and Game Gear boot ROMs supported via Genesis Plus GX.
description: Z80-powered 8-bit console and Game Gear compatible architecture.

name: PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16
biosNotes: HuCard ROMs need no BIOS. CD-ROM² titles require syscard3.pce.
description: Compact HuCard and CD-ROM console engineered by Hudson Soft and NEC.

name: Atari 2600
description: Iconic 6507-based home console featuring the Television Interface Adapter.

name: PlayStation
biosNotes: Requires scph5501.bin (USA), scph5500.bin (JP), or scph5502.bin (EU) for full compatibility.
description: 32-bit CD-ROM optical console powered by MIPS R3000A hardware.

name: Nintendo 64
biosNotes: Standard N64 cartridges do not require an external BIOS file.

name: Nintendo DS
biosNotes: melonDS includes FreeBIOS HLE, or accepts genuine bios7.bin, bios9.bin, and firmware.bin.
description: Dual-screen touchscreen handheld with ARM9 and ARM7 processors.

name: Arcade / Neo Geo (FBNeo / MAME)
biosNotes: Standard MAME 0.139 / arcade ZIPs run via mame2003_plus; Neo Geo MVS/AES archives require neogeo.zip alongside the game ROM archive.
description: Multi-board arcade emulation via FinalBurn Neo and MAME 2003 Plus.
